facts.fact: La Sentinelle reports that in Guelma wilaya the land conservations are digitising property records (94% at Bouchegouf, 80% at two others, about 60% in Guelma town), rural cadastre is complete and urban cadastre about 98%, and the sector now has a land database.

La Sentinelle reports the national platform Fada El Djazair is accessible to citizens and public bodies to consult cadastral plans and request documents remotely, with a further tool, Amlak, still to come.
